messages:
Elena Park: Quick thread to lock down the eval artifact shape + rollout knobs for model onboarding. Our goals: make infra decisions deterministic and give legal a clear audit artifact.

Tom Rivers: Nice. Can you call out the exact fields and where they land? Infra needs machine-readable rules. :computer:

Elena Park: Draft artifact v1 proposed fields: model_name, model_version, run_ts, baseline_hash, quality_deltas (map of slice->pct), golden_query_pass (bool), lat_p50_p95_p99_ms, cost_delta_pct, schema_fingerprint, privacy_review_id, kms_key_id, canary_signature. Location: s3://redwood-bench/evals/<model_name>/<run_ts>/eval-v1.json

Maya Singh: For quality_deltas do we want absolute or relative? Also suggest adding a "regression_budget" number so infra can compute pass/fail without custom logic.

Elena Park: Good call. We'll use absolute percentage points for clarity and include regression_budget default 1.25 (pct points). Example: "quality_deltas": {"intent":0.4, "summ":1.1}, "regression_budget":1.25

Jared Wu: Rollout policy ideas: tenant-scoped canaries + soft-pin window. Concrete proposal: tenant canary 2% or 5k requests for 10 days, soft-pin opt-in period 14 days for enterprise tenants before global swap, final swap only after telemetry stable for 7 days across cohorts.

Tom Rivers: Auto-block rules infra will support from day one: block if any quality_deltas slice > regression_budget OR lat_p95 > configured threshold OR cost_delta_pct > +15. We can point to the artifact path and evaluate via rule engine.

Maya Singh: Add golden queries: store sample queries and expected outputs (hashes) as part of artifact. That helps zero-regression smoke. Also add sample_embeddings_hash for embed-compatible models.

Elena Park: Noted. New artifact keys: golden_queries_hash, sample_embeddings_hash. Also adding "smoke_pass": bool for quick egress compatibility.

ops-bot: CI: bench job queued for model "aurora-lite-rc". job_id=bk-2026-03-24-22 ETA=3h.

Jared Wu: Reverts & runbooks: automatic fallback if anomaly rate >0.4% sustained for 15m OR latency spike p95 increases >30% vs baseline for 10m. Also require manual approval for revert in case of partial data center issues.

Tom Rivers: We'll wire these thresholds to the rollout controller. Need APIs: pauseRollout(tenant_id), forceRevert(model_id, reason), inspectArtifact(path). I'll add endpoints.

Maya Singh: Compliance: EEA/UK tenants need DPA flag and KMS key present. Artifact must include privacy_review_id and confirmation boolean "data_processing_approved".

Elena Park: Timeline: spec + artifact JSON schema by Friday, infra rule engine wiring next week, legal signoff for DPA/KMS step in 10 business days. Can we shorten by parallelizing bench runs with privacy review?

Jared Wu: Yes parallelize where safe. For high-risk tenants require explicit opt-in. For others we can canary earlier.

Elena Park: Next steps: I'll push a short spec doc to docs/ with the artifact schema, example eval file, and rollout flow diagram. Tagging infra (Tom) and legal (Maya) for review. Thanks all. :sparkles:
